title: Bug: Pebble xDrip+ watchface keeps alarming about low smartphone battery
body:
So I really love my Pebble and I really love the integration of xDrip for it.
However, there is one issue for me: 

I have turned off all alarms about low collector / smartphone battery within xDrip+ on my Huawei P20Pro. 
I am using the xDrip+ watchface for Pebble which has no own settings for such alarms.
Pebble keeps vibrating as soon as the smartphone reaches 30%, which is super annoying especially if this happens in the night. It repeats the alarm every 5 or 10 minutes and does also ignores the Pebble silence mode. Also it keeps vibrating if phone is charging until it's >30%...

I don't care about phone battery, especially not during night time. 30% is enough for the complete night and half the morning. 

It would be great if this could be fixed, so either the watchface respects the turned of alarms for battery OR if there was a setting added, where one can change the alarm level to something like 5% or such.

Thanks a lot in advance!

comments.body:
I use pebble myself and have never seen this.

Can you let me know which Pebble model you are using and which of the 3 pebble watch faces that xDrip bundles you are likely using? 

Please also confirm that in `Extra Alerts` -> `Collector battery alerts` you have this switched to off.

Hi @jamorham thanks for your answer!
I double checked an confirm the "collector battery alerts" are switched off. I additionally set them from "30" to "5" (switching them on and off) since I wanted to test if that helps but it did not.
I am using the "Colortrend" watchface. (Farbtrend)
Pebble is a Pebble Time Steel (it's a Kickstarter edition and is of course running on the latest reble OS).

The battery vibration is unique, no other events have the same vibration pattern.

The only way to "reproduce" i found is: If there is no battery indicated on the watchface (bottom left corner is "empty") and then the watchface is receiving the battery level again (thus receiving it from the phone) and displaying it, then the vibration is coming. 
I can not say for sure if that's the same behaviour for the repeated alarms at night.
However, if battery warnings are off, there should be no warning at all, right?!

@jamorham so I did some more testing: I enabled the collector alarms but set them to "5" without any change in behaviour.
The vibration is every 5min when the glucose (so the screen of the Pebble) is updated and battery of the phone is below or equal 30%.
It also happens when due to menu interaction or other the glucose needs to be reloaded or for some reason the phone battery is not shown on the lower left and re-shown.
If using another non x-drip watchface it does not happen at all.
Is the problem still present with the most recent nightly version?
the pebble stills vibrates on 30 percent and everytime the screen of xDrip get's reloaded, e.g. when you return from another screen to the xDrip screen. so I'd say yes, it's still present.
@jstevensog Is there anything we can do about this?

Hi All,
I need a bit more info to help.
Which version of the Pebble watchface are you using, and which version of
xDrip+?
I would recommend running the latest nightly and select the "All platforms"
version of the watch face, as it is the most actively developed.
There is also a settings page in the Pebble app for the watch face, where
you can disable all vibrations (except the No Bluetooth one) to see if that
stops it.

I have not had this reported to me in the last 10 years, but the various
watch faces in xDrip+ are forks of my original, and I am not sure if there
is a but in there or in the xDrip+ code.
Personally, I have never experienced it, but I do have the vibrations
disabled, so that may have something to do with it.

Please raise an issue here with the details and I will see what I can find.
https://github.com/jstevensog/xDrip-Pebble-E/issues
Cheers

Taking a quick look at the PebbleDisplayTrend code, assuming that the watch
face being used is the Trend Clay version, there are only two conditions
where a vibration alert occurs.

   1. When there has been no signal from the transmitter for a period of
   time.
   2. When there is an active BG alert.

In the first case, this will occur every time the watch sends a "heartbeat"
because it hasn't gotten a reading in 6 minutes.
In the second case, it will occur every time the transmitter sends a
reading that is in breach of an alert level that has not been snoozed.

I did program it this way some time ago, so I am doing some archaeology.
There could be a bug in the watch face itself, as it is tracking the phone
battery with low alert with the same flag as the watch battery.  I will
investigate a fix to that and get it into the Pebble Clay Trend version of
the face as soon as possible.

@xannasavin, can you please tell me:

   1. Which Pebble you have?
   2. Which xDrip+ Pebble watch face you have selected?

Cheers
